title: Tunnellio direct TCP bridge
summary: Keyless native Tunnellio TCP bridge. No SSH key, no key registration. Leave everything empty for a server-issued random domain, or pin a reserved domain.
operatorPrepares: Nothing. Press Enter twice for a random domain.
Optional: a reserved domain label if you want a fixed URL.
Optional: an API token if your plan requires one for reserved domains.

notes.expired_domain_fallback: A cached one-day ephemeral domain may expire. When true, the circuit retries once with a fresh random domain instead of failing the start.
notes.domain: Empty means the bridge asks the server for a random domain, which needs no extra conditions.
